hot_issues.title: Linux/GNOME Wayland: support interactive XWayland overlays (meeting capsules / Annotate)
Displays: the list is a startup snapshot, with no change event and no way to add a window later
Cursors: no diagonal resize cursors for corner handles
Expose GPU memory policy and allocation block sizing
Represented file and edited state for macOS windows
WARP / software adapters: a 380 × 1080 panel costs 0.67 CPU-s per frame; damage-limited redraw or a cheaper software path
Windows: let an app turn off the 1 s post-change present hold (STEADY) for windows that don't need it
Input: pointer moves reach elements under a pinned sibling

# Rune A native GPU-rendered Rust UI framework for macOS, Windows, Linux and the web, with its own renderer, text, layout and springs. Every app can run headless, so an agent can render to PNG, dump the element tree and drive it with scripted input.

```rust fn view(s: &State, _: &mut Cx) -> El { let t = tok::theme(true); let label = text(if s.on { "Lights on" } else { "Lights off" }) .font(type_::TITLE).color(t.text); let knob = el().key("knob").size(18.0, 18.0).radius(9.0).fill(t.knob) .absolute(if s.on { 18.0 } else { 2.0 }, 2.0); let switch = el().key("switch").role("switch").label("Lights").checked(s.on) .focusable(true).size(38.0, 22.0).radius(11.0) .fill(if s.on { tok::accent(0, true) } else { t.control_off }) .motion(motion::SNAPPY) .on_press(|s: &mut State| s.on = !s.on) .child(knob); col().w_full().h_full().center().gap(16.0).fill(t.bg).child(label).child(switch) } ``` ## Use it with your agent Give your coding agent this repo. Have it start from [`examples/hello`](examples/hello) and [`crates/rune/README.md`](crates/rune/README.md), then check its own work headlessly by rendering PNGs and inspecting the element tree. > Build me a with Rune (github.com/anomalyco/rune). Start from examples/hello and check your work headlessly. ## Add it ```toml rune = { git = "https://github.com/anomalyco/rune", rev = "" } ``` Rune is pre-release. Pin a rev of `dev`; `dev` is never rewritten. [Docs](crates/rune/README.md) · [Components](crates/rune-kit/README.md) · [Examples](examples) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) ## Contributing We don't take pull requests. Have your agent [open an issue](https://github.com/anomalyco/rune/issues) describing the bug or idea, and our agents usually turn it around fast. MIT, © Anomaly.
